title: Tunisie - Évaluation de la vulnérabilité climatique et sanitaire (Encadré Politique)
geographic_coverage: Tunisia; named governorates include Béja, Ben Arous, Bizerte, Jendouba, Manouba, Tunis, Ariana, Sfax and Nabeul
temporal_coverage: Health and climate baselines; projections through 2100; adaptation recommendations over 1-5 years
methodology: Five-page summary of the 92-page CHVA; flood chart cites FATHOM v3 and Ministry facility data.
limitations: Not full CHVA; scenario and model detail is incomplete.

title: Review of Employment-Intensive Investment Programme (EIIP) water projects in Tunisia
geographic_coverage: Kesra, Oued El Barka, Zaouiet Ben Ammar and Sned Jebel project sites in Siliana, Jendouba, Kasserine and Gafsa governorates
temporal_coverage: 2023 review of EIIP water projects implemented during 2012-2017 and 2018-2025
methodology: Six-page ILO summary of a 2023 review of EIIP project cycles (2012-2017, 2018-2025).
limitations: Project findings, not nationally representative or climate attribution.

title: Country programme document for Tunisia (2021-2025)
geographic_coverage: Tunisia, including coastal zone, rural areas and national regional disparities
temporal_coverage: 2021-2025 country programme; water statistics and coastal indicators mostly dated 2015-2019
methodology: UNDP Executive Board programme document summarizing national climate, water, regional-disparity and institutional indicators and programme priorities.
limitations: Most cited baselines are dated; proposed programme actions are not evidence of delivery or impact.

title: Tunisia
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
geographic_coverage: Tunisia; named localities include Kairouan, Sfax, Sidi Bouzid, Kébili, Tataouine and Kasserine
temporal_coverage: Historical droughts and indicator vintages ranging from 2013 to 2023
methodology: FAO Drought Portal country page organizes social, economic, infrastructure, environmental and institutional drought indicators and consulted sources.
limitations: Indicators have different reference years; page does not provide one integrated local assessment method.

title: Le changement climatique en Tunisie
organization: Institut National de la Météorologie, Ministère du Transport
geographic_coverage: Northern, central and southern Tunisia; named example Nabeul
temporal_coverage: Observed trends 1978-2012; multi-model projections for 2050 and 2100 under RCP4.5 and RCP8.5
methodology: National Meteorological Institute portal summarizes observed national trends and multi-model projections under two RCP pathways.
limitations: Page omits constituent models and downscaling details; its observed trend period ends in 2012.

title: World Bank: Stronger Water Management Could Unlock Growth, Protect Jobs, and Build Resilience in Tunisia
geographic_coverage: Tunisia; national freshwater availability, rural employment and water-sector management
temporal_coverage: Water availability and employment baseline in 2026; economic projections through 2050; Plan Eau 2050
methodology: World Bank press release summarizes the 2026 Tunisia Economic Monitor and its water-scarcity analysis.
limitations: Press release omits the Monitor's detailed modeling, assumptions and subnational breakdown.
